description: Contextual floating panel anchored to a trigger. Use for pickers, menus, and rich tooltips.

trigger.description: Trigger slot. Pass TriggerConfig JSON for a data-driven Button OR a custom ReactNode.

content.description: Floating panel body. Pass ComponentConfig JSON OR a custom ReactNode.

slot_types.ComponentSlot: ComponentConfig JSON (data-driven, registry lookup) OR ReactNode (custom JSX, rendered directly). JSON takes priority.
slot_types.TriggerSlot: TriggerConfig JSON (renders as Button) OR ReactNode (custom JSX, used directly as trigger). JSON takes priority.

note: children prop also accepted as backward-compat alias for content.
